choice_descriptions.DEGRADED: Some customers or a non-critical path are affected, but a usable path remains.
choice_descriptions.OUTAGE: A critical customer operation is unavailable with no usable workaround.

urgency.description: Required response speed under the incident policy.

choice_descriptions.LOW: No active customer impact; backlog handling is sufficient.
choice_descriptions.NORMAL: Active degradation needs prompt business-hours handling.
choice_descriptions.IMMEDIATE: An outage needs immediate incident response.

page_on_call.description: Whether to page the on-call engineer now. Page only for an OUTAGE.

allow_auto_close.description: Whether automation may close the ticket without human review. Never auto-close an OUTAGE, an IMMEDIATE case, or any case that pages on-call.

cases.context: Checkout returns HTTP 500 for every customer. No purchase can complete and there is no workaround.
All sign-in attempts fail. Existing sessions still work, but signed-out customers have no workaround.
Card payments fail for customers in one region. Bank transfer remains available and succeeds.
Search latency increased from 300 ms to 2 seconds for about 20% of requests. Results still load.
The optional CSV export fails for some accounts. The dashboard and API remain available.
One retry failed ten minutes ago. The retry then succeeded and monitoring shows no current customer-facing failure.
A settings-page heading has uneven spacing. Every control works and no customer operation is affected.
A customer asks for a new dark-mode option. Nothing is broken and there is no current customer impact.
The mobile checkout button is unresponsive for some Android customers. The web checkout is a documented working workaround.
The primary database is read-only. All writes fail, customers cannot place or update orders, and no fallback is available.
A deployment to the internal staging environment failed. Production is healthy and customers are unaffected.
Transactional emails arrive 15 minutes late. Customers can still complete every operation and can view receipts in the dashboard.
